HOW THE CHALLENGE WORKS
01 — GET YOUR CHEESE

Choose any Le Pondicherry Cheese product and place your order through our shop.

[ SHOP NOW ]

02 — CREATE YOUR DISH

Bring your recipe to life using the Le Pondicherry Cheese you purchased.

It can be a classic favourite or something nobody has tried before.

Pizza. Pasta. Dosa. Sandwich. Burger. Your signature creation.

There are no limits to your creativity.

03 — START YOUR REEL RIGHT

Your Reel needs to clearly introduce the challenge from the beginning.

Within the first 10 seconds, show:

The Le Pondicherry Cheese product you purchased
The dish you're going to create

For example:

“I bought Le Pondicherry Fresh Mozzarella, and today I'm making a cheesy pizza!”

Make the cheese visible. Make the idea clear. Then let your creativity take over.

04 — POST IT ON INSTAGRAM

Post your cooking video as a Reel on your public Instagram account.

Don't forget to:

Tag @LePondicherryCheese

and use the official campaign hashtag.

05 — SUBMIT YOUR ENTRY

Copy your Instagram Reel URL and submit it through the entry form.

Once your entry is verified, your 21-day reach period begins from the Reel's publication date.

Then it's time to get people watching.

Share your Reel. Tell your friends. Get your community involved.

Your reach matters.

YOUR 21 DAYS. YOUR REEL. YOUR CHANCE.

Every participant gets their own 21-day reach period.

That means the competition isn't simply about who posts first.

Your Reel gets its own 21-day window to reach as many people as possible.

At the end of your 21 days, your eligible Reel's final reach is recorded.

The participant with the highest eligible reach at the end of their competition period wins the Electric Scooter.

So don't just make a Reel. Make people want to watch it.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Who can participate?

Anyone who meets the campaign participation requirements can participate.

Do I need to buy Le Pondicherry Cheese?

Yes. Participants must purchase a Le Pondicherry Cheese product to enter the challenge.

Can I use any Le Pondicherry Cheese product?

Yes. The challenge allows participants to create their dish using a purchased Le Pondicherry Cheese product, subject to the campaign requirements.

What should my Reel contain?

Your Reel must feature a dish made using the Le Pondicherry Cheese you purchased.

The first 10 seconds must clearly show the purchased product and what dish you are going to create.

Does my Instagram account need to be public?

Yes. Your Instagram account must remain public so the Reel can be viewed and its reach can be verified.

How long do I have to build my reach?

You get 21 days from the date your Reel is published.

Each participant's 21-day period is calculated separately based on their Reel publication date.

How is the winner decided?

The participant whose eligible Reel records the highest reach at the end of their applicable 21-day period wins the First Prize.

Can I share my Reel with friends?

Yes. You can share your Reel and encourage people to watch it.

However, fake, purchased or artificially generated engagement may result in disqualification.

Can I see who is currently leading?

Yes. Visit the campaign Leaderboard to see the current rankings.

[ VIEW LEADERBOARD → ]

What happens if my Reel is deleted or made private?

Your Reel must remain publicly available during the applicable competition and reach measurement period. Entries that become unavailable may be considered invalid.

BEFORE YOU COOK, KNOW THE RULES

Participation in the challenge means agreeing to the official campaign Terms & Conditions.

The key requirements include:

Participation

Participants must purchase a Le Pondicherry Cheese product and use a public Instagram account.

Reel Requirements

The Reel must feature a dish made using the purchased cheese, be original content, tag the official Le Pondicherry Cheese Instagram account and follow the campaign requirements.

21-Day Reach Period

Each participant receives a 21-day period beginning from the publication of their Reel. The final eligible reach recorded during this period is considered.

Winner

The participant with the highest eligible reach receives the First Prize: an Electric Scooter.

Invalid Entries

Entries involving fake or purchased engagement, bots, artificially generated traffic, copied content, misleading information, unavailable Reels or other violations of the campaign requirements may be disqualified.

Content Usage

By participating, you grant Le Pondicherry Cheese permission to repost your submitted Reel and use the content for campaign-related marketing and promotional purposes, subject to the applicable terms.

Campaign Changes

Le Pondicherry Cheese reserves the right to modify, extend, pause or cancel the campaign where necessary. Important changes will be communicated through the campaign's official channels.
